approval: Approved by user on 2026-10-06: Allow these two exact diagnostics. Scope limited to BigInt digit initialization and Wasm tiering-budget loading; no compiler flag changes.

root_cause.BigInt: The real UnalignedValueMember<uint64_t> consists solely of protected byte storage. GCC warns about member access although the type is trivially copyable and memset initializes its complete representation. All 256 byte patterns represent valid unsigned digits.
root_cause.Wasm_tiering: The distribution std::atomic<uint32_t> is trivially copyable with the same size as uint32_t; copy assignment is deleted, which triggers the diagnostic. Deserialization fills the new module before exposing it to callers; this initializes its budget array from serialized uint32_t representations; running code cannot concurrently use this new module. The existing input-size check rejects incomplete budget data.
